title: A Rough Election Night for the Democrats

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for Dealbook, a daily newsletter at the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日通讯《Dealbook》报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的Dealbook峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的人物，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk,
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、

sentences.en: Christine Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the Dealbook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼等许多人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话实况。

sentences.en: We're going to be live streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 我们将在11月18日通过nytimes.com进行部分采访的直播，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅用户，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻报道的一个月免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From New York Times, I'm Michael Balbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: This is a daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今日话题。

sentences.en: Why Democrats fared so poorly in so many different parts of the country in
sentences.zh: 为什么民主党在全国这么多不同地区表现得如此糟糕，

sentences.en: Tuesday's closely watched elections.
sentences.zh: 在周二备受关注的选举中。

sentences.en: I asked my colleague, national political correspondent,
sentences.zh: 我询问了我的同事，国家政治记者，

sentences.en: Alex Burns.
sentences.zh: 亚历克斯·伯恩斯。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, November 4th.
sentences.zh: 今天是11月4日，星期四。

sentences.en: Hey, Mr. Burns.
sentences.zh: 嘿，伯恩斯先生。

sentences.en: It has been a really, really long time since you were on the show.
sentences.zh: 你已经很久很久没有上过这个节目了。

sentences.en: In fact, I did some math.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我算了一下。

sentences.en: It's been eight months.
sentences.zh: 已经八个月了。

sentences.en: Has it really?
sentences.zh: 真的吗？

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I've counted every single day with one of those dramatic X's on the calendar.
sentences.zh: 我在日历上用那些戏剧性的叉号记录了每一天。

sentences.en: And it's extremely fitting that after all that time and all that bereftness on our part, you return on the day of the very first big election since you left.
sentences.zh: 而且非常巧合的是，在我们经历了那么长时间的空缺后，你竟然在离开后的第一次大选日回归了。

sentences.en: I did not plan it out that way.
sentences.zh: 我并没有这样计划。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不。

sentences.en: But it did kind of work out.
sentences.zh: 但确实凑巧赶上了。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不。

sentences.en: I just kind of ran out of time off.
sentences.zh: 我只是刚好休假结束了。

sentences.en: But here I am just in time for these elections.
sentences.zh: 但我刚好赶上了这次选举。

sentences.en: So speaking of this election, it felt like all of us were focused pretty much exclusively on the governor's race in Virginia and the story
sentences.zh: 说到这次选举，感觉我们所有人都几乎只关注弗吉尼亚州的州长竞选，以及那里

sentences.en: there about an unexpectedly close conteSt. So how did that all unfold for you?
sentences.zh: 一场出人意料的胶着选战。那么，这一切对你来说是如何展开的？

sentences.en: I think that's totally right.
sentences.zh: 我认为你说得完全正确。

sentences.en: Going into the night really felt like Virginia was the main show.
sentences.zh: 进入选举之夜时，感觉弗吉尼亚州确实是重头戏。

sentences.en: It's a state that's trended towards Democrats over the last decade.
sentences.zh: 在过去十年里，该州一直倾向于民主党。

sentences.en: But where you had a Republican candidate, Glenn Youngkin, a newcomer to politics, a business guy, running an unexpectedly
sentences.zh: 但那里有一位共和党候选人格伦·杨金，一个政治新人，一个商人，正在进行一场出人意料的

sentences.en: strong race against Terry McAuliffe, the former Democratic governor who's trying to make a political comeback.
sentences.zh: 强劲竞选，挑战试图政治复出的前民主党州长特里·麦考利夫。

sentences.en: And it really seemed like the question hanging over the whole night was, can Glenn Youngkin pull off this distinctively strong performance in a tough state?
sentences.zh: 整晚悬而未决的问题似乎确实是：格伦·杨金能在这样一个艰难的州取得如此出色的表现吗？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And as the night went on, and as it became clearer and clearer that, yeah, Glenn Youngkin probably was going to pull that off, we start to look beyond Virginia.
sentences.zh: 随着夜色渐深，格伦·杨金很可能会成功这一点变得越来越清晰，我们开始将目光投向弗吉尼亚州之外。

sentences.en: And we start to see evidence that maybe this isn't a singular event.
sentences.zh: 我们开始看到证据，这可能不是一个孤立事件。

sentences.en: Maybe there's something happening here that relates to the larger fabric of
sentences.zh: 也许这里发生的事情与美国政治的更大格局，

sentences.en: American politics and the position of the two parties beyond Virginia.
sentences.zh: 以及两党在弗吉尼亚州之外的处境有关。

sentences.en: And what was that?
sentences.zh: 那是什么？

sentences.en: You start to see Republicans doing quite well in places where they typically have not done well for some time.
sentences.zh: 你开始看到共和党人在他们长期以来表现不佳的地方做得相当不错。

sentences.en: Talk about close in our tally right now.
sentences.zh: 说说我们目前的计票情况。

sentences.en: There it is.
sentences.zh: 就在那里。

sentences.en: 61 votes at this hour separating Jack Cittarelli, the Republican challenger, Phil Murphy, the Democratic incumbent.
sentences.zh: 此时此刻，共和党挑战者杰克·奇塔雷利与民主党现任州长菲尔·墨菲之间仅有61票之差。

sentences.en: There's a governor's race in New Jersey where the incumbent Democratic governor, Phil Murphy,
sentences.zh: 新泽西州有一场州长竞选，现任民主党州长菲尔·墨菲，

sentences.en: a pretty popular guy, was trailing slightly for much of the night and into the morning to an obscure
sentences.zh: 一个相当受欢迎的人，在整个晚上和第二天早上一直略微落后于一位名不见经传的

sentences.en: Republican challenger.
sentences.zh: 共和党挑战者。

sentences.en: It was a very tough night of election results for the Democrats and a major victory for the Republicans.
sentences.zh: 这对民主党来说是一个非常艰难的选举之夜，也是共和党的重大胜利。

sentences.en: You saw Republican candidates doing very well in the suburbs of New York City, in parts of
sentences.zh: 你看到共和党候选人在纽约市郊区、长岛部分地区表现非常出色，

sentences.en: Long Island, where the GOP has not been doing quite so well in recent years.
sentences.zh: 而共和党近年来在这些地方的表现并不太好。

sentences.en: On Long Island, two key races being decided in Nassau County for District Attorney Republican
sentences.zh: 在长岛，拿骚县地方检察官的两个关键席位正在决出，共和党人

sentences.en: Ann Donnelly is claiming victory over Democrat Todd Kaminsky.
sentences.zh: 安·唐纳利宣布战胜民主党人托德·卡明斯基。

sentences.en: And in the race for Nassau County Executive Republican challenger Bruce Blakeman is leading
sentences.zh: 在拿骚县县长竞选中，共和党挑战者布鲁斯·布莱克曼目前领先于

sentences.en: Democratic incumbent Laura Curran right now.
sentences.zh: 民主党现任县长劳拉·柯伦。

sentences.en: Blakeman is ahead.
sentences.zh: 布莱克曼领先。

sentences.en: And so as more information starts to trickle in, Virginia starts to look less and less like an isolated story of one guy on the Republican side running an upset campaign.
sentences.zh: 随着更多信息开始传出，弗吉尼亚州看起来越来越不像是一个共和党人发动意外竞选的孤立故事。

sentences.en: And it starts to look more and more like Democrats in general are having a pretty rough night.
sentences.zh: 它看起来越来越像是民主党人整体上度过了一个相当糟糕的夜晚。

sentences.en: And let's talk about why that is and how you explain that.
sentences.zh: 让我们谈谈原因以及你如何解释这一点。

sentences.en: I know it's only been 24 hours, but we have a lot of data on your quick study.
sentences.zh: 我知道才过去24小时，但我们有很多关于你快速研究的数据。

sentences.en: So what are the biggest factors in your mind as you assess what happened in those three places on Tuesday?
sentences.zh: 那么在你看来，评估周二在上述三个地方发生的事情时，最大的因素是什么？

sentences.en: Well, the single biggest backdrop for all of this is that we have a Democratic president who is not very popular right now, including in these states that voted for him a year ago.
sentences.zh: 好吧，这一切最大的背景是，我们有一位目前不太受欢迎的民主党总统，包括在这些一年前投票支持他的州。

sentences.en: How not popular?
sentences.zh: 有多不受欢迎？

sentences.en: The public opinion data varies.
sentences.zh: 公众舆论数据各不相同。

sentences.en: But in New Jersey, where Biden won by 16 points in 2020, and in Virginia, where he beat Donald Trump
sentences.zh: 但在2020年拜登以16个百分点获胜的新泽西州，以及他以10个百分点击败唐纳德·特朗普的弗吉尼亚州，

sentences.en: by 10 points, his disapproval ratings are pretty consistently higher than his approval ratings.
sentences.zh: 他的不支持率相当一致地高于支持率。

sentences.en: And in some cases, by wide margins.
sentences.zh: 在某些情况下，差距还很大。

sentences.en: The share of voters who say that the country is on the wrong track is massive in these states.
sentences.zh: 在这些州，认为国家走在错误轨道上的选民比例非常巨大。

sentences.en: People are frustrated and exasperated by the long tail of the coronavirus pandemic.
sentences.zh: 人们对新冠疫情的长期影响感到沮丧和愤怒。

sentences.en: The economy has not recovered as quickly as they expected it to.
sentences.zh: 经济复苏的速度没有他们预期的那么快。

sentences.en: The public health restrictions that we've been living with for so long have not gone away as quickly as people hoped.
sentences.zh: 我们长期以来一直忍受的公共卫生限制措施并没有像人们希望的那样迅速消失。

sentences.en: On top of that, this is the first election in half a decade where Donald Trump is not on the ballot, either literally or figuratively.
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，这是半个世纪以来唐纳德·特朗普无论是字面上还是象征意义上都没有出现在选票上的第一次选举。

sentences.en: There's not this great motivating force for Democrats and for moderate voters who dislike Trump-style politics
sentences.zh: 对于那些讨厌特朗普式政治的民主党人和温和派选民来说，

sentences.en: to get out there and repudiate the Republican Party the way there has been for so long.
sentences.zh: 不再有那种强大的动力去站出来抵制共和党，就像过去很长一段时间那样。

sentences.en: So you put all that together, and what you get is areas that normally look relatively or very blue start to look considerably less friendly to Democrats.
sentences.zh: 所以把所有这些加在一起，你得到的结果是，那些通常看起来相对或非常“蓝色”的地区，开始对民主党人显得不那么友好。

sentences.en: Let's get a little granular here and talk about how these factors you just identified
sentences.zh: 让我们深入探讨一下，谈谈你刚才确定的这些因素

sentences.en: show up in the results from Tuesday in these three places, Virginia, New Jersey, and Long Island.
sentences.zh: 是如何在周二弗吉尼亚州、新泽西州和长岛这三个地方的选举结果中体现出来的。

sentences.en: And here we should say, Alex, we are talking to you at 4 p.m.
sentences.zh: 在这里我们应该说明，亚历克斯，我们是在周三下午4点采访你，

sentences.en: on Wednesday, so there is not a final call yet in a few of these races, most notably the New Jersey governor's race.
sentences.zh: 所以其中一些竞选还没有最终结果，最引人注目的是新泽西州的州长竞选。

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: The big race that has been called is the race in Virginia.
sentences.zh: 已经宣布结果的大型竞选是弗吉尼亚州的竞选。

sentences.en: And that is where you had Glenn Youngkin, the Republican candidate,
sentences.zh: 在那里，共和党候选人格伦·杨金，

sentences.en: walking this very, very careful line for the entire duration of the general election, of trying to connect with Donald Trump's core supporters, voters in rural Virginia,
sentences.zh: 在整个大选期间走了一条非常非常谨慎的路线，试图与唐纳德·特朗普的核心支持者、弗吉尼亚州农村地区的选民建立联系，

sentences.en: and particularly white voters in rural Virginia, while broadening the support of the Republican Party
sentences.zh: 特别是弗吉尼亚州农村地区的白人选民，同时扩大共和党的支持基础，

sentences.en: to include a whole lot of those centrist and center-right suburban and outer suburban voters who really abandoned the GOP in droves during the Trump era.
sentences.zh: 以涵盖大量在特朗普时代大规模背弃共和党的中间派和中右翼郊区及外郊区选民。

sentences.en: And he did this in a couple big ways.
sentences.zh: 他通过几种主要方式做到了这一点。

sentences.en: One of them was just a classic Republican candidate playbook of running as an outsider business guy who's going to shake things up when he gets into government.
sentences.zh: 其中之一就是经典的共和党候选人策略，即以局外人商人的身份参选，承诺一旦进入政府就会做出改变。

sentences.en: He ran, on some issues, a pretty moderate message, talking about increasing funding for education and increasing teacher salaries.
sentences.zh: 他在一些议题上提出了相当温和的信息，谈论增加教育投入和提高教师工资。

sentences.en: These are messages that would be very familiar to Republicans in an earlier pre-Trump era of politics in a place like Virginia.
sentences.zh: 这些信息对于弗吉尼亚州这类地方在特朗普时代之前的早期政治中的共和党人来说是非常熟悉的。

sentences.en: And at the same time, he is sort of more quietly talking to Trump's base, in some respects in coded language, talking about parental choice in education,
sentences.zh: 与此同时，他在某些方面以更隐晦的语言与特朗普的选民基础进行交流，谈论教育中的家长选择权，

sentences.en: talking about critical race theory, subjects that do not necessarily appeal to a wide cross-section of the Virginia electorate,
sentences.zh: 谈论批判性种族理论，这些主题并不一定能吸引弗吉尼亚州广泛的选民群体，

sentences.en: but that for voters on the right are just really important buttons for him to push.
sentences.zh: 但对于右翼选民来说，这些确实是他需要触动的关键点。

sentences.en: He never appeared with Donald Trump in the general election.
sentences.zh: 他在大选中从未与唐纳德·特朗普一起露面。

sentences.en: He managed to keep Trump away from the state, and Trump agreed to stay away from the state despite Democrats trying so hard to bait him into the fight
sentences.zh: 他成功地让特朗普远离该州，尽管民主党人极力诱导他参与这场斗争，但特朗普同意远离该州，

sentences.en: because the strong conviction on the Democratic side was if Donald Trump sets foot in Virginia, if they get a photo of Donald Trump and Glenn Youngkin next to each other,
sentences.zh: 因为民主党方面坚信，如果唐纳德·特朗普踏入弗吉尼亚州，如果他们拍到唐纳德·特朗普和格伦·杨金并肩的照片，

sentences.en: that's just toxic in a state like that.
sentences.zh: 在这样一个州，那简直是毒药。

sentences.en: But it just never happened.
sentences.zh: 但这从未发生过。

sentences.en: So in the homestretch of the race, you had Terry McAuliffe, the former Democratic governor,
sentences.zh: 所以在竞选的最后冲刺阶段，前民主党州长特里·麦考利夫，

sentences.en: blanketing the airwaves with ads linking Youngkin to Trump, and it just did not quite stick.
sentences.zh: 在广播电视上铺天盖地地投放广告，将杨金与特朗普联系起来，但这并没有奏效。

sentences.en: And so when you get a pretty complete set of results in, Glenn Youngkin wins the race, not a landslide, but by a couple percentage points, and this state that Joe Biden carried
sentences.zh: 因此，当相当完整的结果出来时，格伦·杨金赢得了竞选，虽然不是压倒性胜利，但以几个百分点的优势获胜，而这个乔·拜登一年前还以10个百分点获胜的州，

sentences.en: by 10 points just a year earlier, it looks a little redder everywhere.
sentences.zh: 到处看起来都更偏向红色了。

sentences.en: And you see less enthusiasm in Democratic areas to turn out and vote.
sentences.zh: 你看到民主党地区的投票热情降低了。

sentences.en: You see in the big, dense suburbs, McAuliffe is still winning.
sentences.zh: 你看到在人口稠密的大郊区，麦考利夫仍然在获胜。

sentences.en: They're still Democratic areas, but they look a little bit less blue than they did a year ago.
sentences.zh: 它们仍然是民主党地区，但看起来比一年前不那么“蓝”了。

sentences.en: And the rural areas look super, super red.
sentences.zh: 而农村地区看起来非常、非常红。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Let's turn now to New Jersey and how all the factors you've identified here played out in that race.
sentences.zh: 现在让我们转向新泽西州，看看你在这里确定的所有因素是如何在那场竞选中发挥作用的。

sentences.en: So New Jersey is in some ways an even more staggering result.
sentences.zh: 所以新泽西州的结果在某些方面甚至更令人震惊。

sentences.en: It looks like the Democrat, Phil Murphy, will likely prevail in the end.
sentences.zh: 看起来民主党人菲尔·墨菲最终可能会获胜。

sentences.en: But he had every advantage in this race.
sentences.zh: 但他在这场竞选中拥有所有优势。

sentences.en: He's a relatively popular governor.
sentences.zh: 他是一位相对受欢迎的州长。

sentences.en: He's a very well-funded campaign.
sentences.zh: 他的竞选资金非常充足。

sentences.en: His Republican opponent is a guy named Jack Cittarelli, a former Republican state legislator who, by any reasonable measure, is quite an obscure candidate.
sentences.zh: 他的共和党对手是一个叫杰克·奇塔雷利的人，一位前共和党州议员，无论从什么合理的标准来看，他都是一位相当名不见经传的候选人。

sentences.en: He's not a well-known figure.
sentences.zh: 他不是一个知名人物。

sentences.en: He doesn't have a personal fortune.
sentences.zh: 他没有个人财富。

sentences.en: He has very little muscle behind him from the National Republican Party.
sentences.zh: 他几乎没有得到全国共和党的支持。

sentences.en: But the way the race unfolded, this Republican candidate is attacking Murphy for his management of COVID.
sentences.zh: 但竞选展开的方式是，这位共和党候选人攻击墨菲对新冠疫情的管理。

sentences.en: What infuriated a great many New Jerseyans were the inconsistencies in the executive orders during the lockdown.
sentences.zh: 让许多新泽西人感到愤怒的是封锁期间行政命令的不一致。

sentences.en: He's revving up voters who feel like it's time to move on from all those public health restrictions.
sentences.zh: 他正在激励那些觉得是时候摆脱所有这些公共卫生限制的选民。

sentences.en: That one out of three small businesses in New Jersey, mom-and-pop shops that were in families for decades, have closed their doors forever.
sentences.zh: 新泽西州三分之一的小企业，那些家族经营了几十年的夫妻店，已经永远关门了。

sentences.en: And he's also hitting some pretty traditional New Jersey Republican themes, like property taxes.
sentences.zh: 他还触及了一些非常传统的新泽西共和党主题，比如房产税。

sentences.en: Everyone knows we're the highest taxed people in the nation.
sentences.zh: 每个人都知道我们是全国税负最高的人群。

sentences.en: And we think Phil Murphy got a pass four years ago, but he's been in office now for four years nearly.
sentences.zh: 我们认为菲尔·墨菲四年前蒙混过关了，但他现在已经执政近四年了。

sentences.en: And we're going to remind people who he is, someone who thinks if taxes are your issue, we're probably not your state.
sentences.zh: 我们要提醒人们他是谁，一个认为如果税收是你的问题，我们可能不是适合你的州的人。

sentences.en: He's basically telling you to leave.
sentences.zh: 他基本上是在叫你离开。

sentences.en: It is as close to a generic Republican campaign as we have seen in that state since Chris Christie left office.
sentences.zh: 这是自克里斯·克里斯蒂卸任以来，我们在该州见过的最接近普通共和党竞选的案例。

sentences.en: And what we start to see as the results roll in is, gosh, it sure seems to have worked in a lot of places.
sentences.zh: 随着结果出炉，我们开始看到，天哪，它在很多地方确实奏效了。

sentences.en: And you see reflected across New Jersey some of the same dynamics we spoke about in Virginia, but actually on steroids.
sentences.zh: 你在新泽西州反映出了一些我们在弗吉尼亚州谈到的相同动态，但实际上是加剧了。

sentences.en: Democratic turnout is just down.
sentences.zh: 民主党的投票率确实下降了。

sentences.en: The more rural parts of the state, voters show up in force.
sentences.zh: 在该州更偏远的农村地区，选民们倾巢出动。

sentences.en: The big suburbs near New York City and in central New Jersey, they're still blue.
sentences.zh: 纽约市附近和新泽西州中部的大郊区，它们仍然是蓝色的。

sentences.en: Phil Murphy is still carrying them, but he's not carrying them the way he did four years ago.
sentences.zh: 菲尔·墨菲仍然在这些地方获胜，但他赢得并不像四年前那样轻松。

sentences.en: If this is starting to sound familiar, it's because it is very similar in the underlying dynamics to what we see in Virginia.
sentences.zh: 如果这听起来很熟悉，那是因为它在潜在动态上与我们在弗吉尼亚州看到的情况非常相似。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: And what about Long Island?
sentences.zh: 那么长岛呢？

sentences.en: And I must ask, why are we talking about Long Island and putting it in the same group as the august states of Virginia and New Jersey?
sentences.zh: 我必须问，为什么我们要谈论长岛，并把它和弗吉尼亚州和新泽西州这些大州归为一类？

sentences.en: If you ask yourself at this stage, are we looking at a change in the national political environment?
sentences.zh: 如果你在这个阶段问自己，我们是否正在目睹国家政治环境的变化？

sentences.en: Or are we looking at a couple of governor's races where Democrats blew it for pretty narrow reasons?
sentences.zh: 还是我们只是在看几场民主党因为相当狭隘的原因而搞砸的州长竞选？

sentences.en: You could look to a place like Long Island and ask yourself, do we see the same dynamics there?
sentences.zh: 你可以看看像长岛这样的地方，问问自己，我们在那里看到了同样的动态吗？

sentences.en: Do we see more conservative and moderate suburban voters turning against the Democratic Party?
sentences.zh: 我们是否看到更多保守和温和的郊区选民背弃民主党？

sentences.en: And the answer is yes.
sentences.zh: 答案是肯定的。

sentences.en: There are a couple important races out there, a Nassau County executive, district attorney there, Suffolk County, a DA, where it seems that Democrats who appeared to be in a strong
sentences.zh: 那里有几场重要的竞选，拿骚县县长、地方检察官，萨福克县的地方检察官，似乎一年前、六个月前或六周前看起来处于强势地位的民主党人，

sentences.en: position a year ago or six months ago or six weeks ago, either lost or are trailing.
sentences.zh: 要么输了，要么正在落后。

sentences.en: Interesting.
sentences.zh: 有意思。

sentences.en: And particularly, this is counterintuitive in some ways, that you would think that the biggest, best-funded election is the one to watch for signals of where things are headed.
sentences.zh: 特别是在某些方面，这其实有悖常理，你可能会认为选举资金最雄厚、规模最大的选区，才是观察局势走向的风向标。

sentences.en: But in some ways, as you move down the ballot, that's where voters are just sort of pulling
sentences.zh: 但在某种程度上，随着你关注的选区级别降低，选民们往往只是

sentences.en: the lever for one party or the other because they don't know as much about the candidates.
sentences.zh: 因为对候选人了解不多，而直接投给某一个政党。

sentences.en: You know, people in Virginia, they know who Glenn Youngkin is.
sentences.zh: 你知道，弗吉尼亚州的选民很清楚格伦·扬金是谁。

sentences.en: He spent tens of millions of dollars to educate them about that.
sentences.zh: 他花了数千万美元来让他们了解这一点。

sentences.en: You have some elections in New Jersey for the state legislature where entrenched Democrats are losing to total nobodies.
sentences.zh: 在新泽西州的一些州议会选举中，根基深厚的民主党人竟然输给了名不见经传的对手。

sentences.en: That's not because the nobodies ran excellent campaigns.
sentences.zh: 这并不是因为那些无名小卒开展了多么出色的竞选活动。

sentences.en: That's because the electorate soured on Democrats in that area.
sentences.zh: 而是因为该地区的选民对民主党感到失望。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And decided to turn to Republicans.
sentences.zh: 并决定转向共和党。

sentences.en: It's the only alternative they've got.
sentences.zh: 这是他们唯一的选择。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们稍后回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》App？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁了？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道，你需要订阅《纽约时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果能免费试用《纽约时报》一个月，且无需绑定信用卡呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 首次下载《纽约时报》App，即可免费畅读第一个月。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看时报订阅者每天都能读到什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载App，获取30天免费阅读权限。

sentences.en: So, Alex, let's talk about what these results mean for both parties as they think about their immediate political future, which for both parties are the midterm elections next year
sentences.zh: 那么，亚历克斯，我们来谈谈这些结果对两党意味着什么，尤其是考虑到他们眼前的政治未来——对两党而言，就是明年的中期选举，

sentences.en: that could determine control of Congress.
sentences.zh: 这可能会决定国会的控制权。

sentences.en: And let's start with the Republicans.
sentences.zh: 我们先从共和党说起。

sentences.en: What big lessons do you think national Republicans have taken from Tuesday?
sentences.zh: 你认为全国共和党人从周二的选举中吸取了哪些重大教训？

sentences.en: I think the bottom line for national Republicans looking at Tuesday is the notion that running a pretty traditional Republican campaign is enough to get the job done in some pretty
sentences.zh: 我认为全国共和党人从周二选举中得出的核心结论是：开展一场相当传统的共和党竞选活动，就足以在一些非常

sentences.en: tough places.
sentences.zh: 艰难的选区取得胜利。

sentences.en: You don't need to wear a red MAGA hat to get Donald Trump's voters out to the polls.
sentences.zh: 你不需要戴着红色的“让美国再次伟大”（MAGA）帽子，也能动员唐纳德·特朗普的选民去投票。

sentences.en: They're going to be there for you if these races are any indication.
sentences.zh: 如果这些竞选结果有任何参考意义的话，他们会支持你的。

sentences.en: And so if you count on the support from right-wing voters, Trump voters in rural areas, and you
sentences.zh: 因此，如果你能依靠右翼选民和农村地区特朗普支持者的支持，并且

sentences.en: modulate your pitch a little bit so that you sound somewhat more like Mitt Romney than Donald
sentences.zh: 稍微调整一下你的竞选口号，让你听起来更像米特·罗姆尼，而不是唐纳德·

sentences.en: Trump, then there are other voters who are still open to you.
sentences.zh: 特朗普，那么其他选民依然会愿意接受你。

sentences.en: That if there was this fear that Donald Trump absolutely demolished his party with independent
sentences.zh: 如果此前人们担心唐纳德·特朗普彻底摧毁了共和党在独立选民中

sentences.en: voters for a generation, that sure doesn't seem to be the case looking at the results from this week.
sentences.zh: 一代人的支持率，那么从本周的结果来看，情况显然并非如此。

sentences.en: And I think, Alex, that was an open question, especially when it came to moderates.
sentences.zh: 亚历克斯，我认为这确实是一个悬而未决的问题，尤其是在温和派选民方面。

sentences.en: Did Donald Trump, especially after January 6th, especially after the role he played in the
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普，特别是在1月6日之后，特别是在他在

sentences.en: assault on the Capitol, essentially destroy his party's appeal to certain kind of moderate voters?
sentences.zh: 国会山骚乱中扮演的角色之后，是否从根本上摧毁了他所在政党对某些温和派选民的吸引力？

sentences.en: And it seems like you're saying the answer is no, if the candidates running as Republicans keep their distance.
sentences.zh: 而你似乎在说答案是否定的，只要以共和党身份参选的候选人与他保持距离即可。

sentences.en: Well, there are absolutely moderate voters who are off limits to Republicans now because of Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 嗯，确实有一些温和派选民因为唐纳德·特朗普而不再支持共和党。

sentences.en: But there are also some moderate voters who are willing to look at the GOP again and say,
sentences.zh: 但也有一些温和派选民愿意重新审视共和党，并说：

sentences.en: well, you know, I left them for a few years, but I like what this guy is saying about education and taxes.
sentences.zh: “你知道，我离开他们几年了，但我喜欢这个人关于教育和税收的说法。”

sentences.en: And so he doesn't seem too much like Trump.
sentences.zh: 而且他看起来并不太像特朗普。

sentences.en: But as you alluded to, the challenge there is you need to not seem too much like Trump.
sentences.zh: 但正如你所提到的，其中的挑战在于你不能表现得太像特朗普。

sentences.en: And, you know, if you're a national Republican and somebody said to you, you know, I can guarantee
sentences.zh: 而且，如果你是一名全国性的共和党人，有人对你说：“我可以保证

sentences.en: you that Donald Trump will not leave Mar-a-Lago for the entire calendar year 2022, I think you
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普在2022年全年都不会离开海湖庄园”，我想你

sentences.en: would feel pretty good about your chances in the midterm elections, just based on what we see about the national atmospherics right now.
sentences.zh: 会对自己在中期选举中的胜算感到相当乐观，仅从我们目前看到的全国氛围来看。

sentences.en: But obviously nobody can guarantee that.
sentences.zh: 但显然没人能保证这一点。

sentences.en: There are already sort of signs from Trump the last few hours of sort of frustration that he doesn't seem to be getting credit for Glenn Youngkin winning in Virginia.
sentences.zh: 过去几个小时里，特朗普已经表现出某种沮丧，因为他似乎没有因格伦·扬金在弗吉尼亚州的胜利而获得赞誉。

sentences.en: Yeah, putting out statements saying, you know, the only reason why this race was even closed
sentences.zh: 是的，他发表声明说，这场竞选之所以胶着，

sentences.en: was because of the MAGA base, which is true that if rural conservatives deserted Republicans in the absence of Donald Trump, that'd be very, very bad for the Republican Party.
sentences.zh: 完全是因为MAGA基本盘。确实，如果农村保守派在没有唐纳德·特朗普的情况下抛弃共和党，那对共和党来说将是非常非常糟糕的。

sentences.en: But the amazing thing is that they didn't desert the Republican Party, and Donald Trump didn't go to Virginia to ask them to show up.
sentences.zh: 但令人惊奇的是，他们并没有抛弃共和党，而唐纳德·特朗普也没有去弗吉尼亚州呼吁他们出来投票。

sentences.en: So it does seem like there is a path here for relatively traditional Republican candidates
sentences.zh: 所以，相对传统的共和党候选人似乎确实有一条路径，

sentences.en: to pull in that support from rural conservatives without campaigning like or with Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 可以在不以唐纳德·特朗普的方式或与他一同竞选的情况下，争取到农村保守派的支持。

sentences.en: But Alex, we know that Donald Trump has inspired a certain kind of Republican candidate to seek federal office, to run for House seats and Senate seats.
sentences.zh: 但亚历克斯，我们知道唐纳德·特朗普激励了某种特定的共和党候选人去竞选联邦公职，去争夺众议院和参议院席位。

sentences.en: So the question is, are there lots of those candidates in the pipeline for this upcoming midterm that may not fit the pattern of the Youngkin or the Chittarelli?
sentences.zh: 所以问题是，在即将到来的中期选举中，是否还有很多这样的候选人，他们可能并不符合扬金或奇塔雷利的模式？

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I mean, if Republicans could clone Glenn Youngkin and run him in every Senate race in 2022, that would be a really good strategy.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，如果共和党人能克隆格伦·扬金，并让他参加2022年的每一场参议院竞选，那将是一个非常好的策略。

sentences.en: It is not one that's available to them.
sentences.zh: 但这并不是他们能做到的。

sentences.en: And Michael, it's worth noting here that a distinctive characteristic of both of these races was that there was not a long, drawn-out, competitive Republican primary where you had
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，值得注意的是，这两场竞选的一个显著特点是，没有经过漫长、拖沓且竞争激烈的共和党初选，没有出现

sentences.en: different ambitious conservatives pushing each other to the right and pushing themselves further and further towards Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 不同的雄心勃勃的保守派互相推向右翼，并将自己进一步推向唐纳德·特朗普的情况。

sentences.en: That's likely to happen in many or all of the important federal elections next year.
sentences.zh: 这种情况很可能会在明年许多或所有重要的联邦选举中发生。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Let's turn to Democrats.
sentences.zh: 让我们转向民主党。

sentences.en: What does Tuesday's results mean for the Democrats as they fight to try to keep control of both chambers of Congress?
sentences.zh: 周二的结果对民主党在努力保住国会两院控制权的过程中意味着什么？

sentences.en: Look, I think in the big picture, it is a very, very bracing message for Democrats who have tiny margins to defend in the House and Senate.
sentences.zh: 听着，我认为从大局来看，这对在众议院和参议院仅有微弱优势的民主党人来说，是一个非常非常严峻的信号。

sentences.en: Talking to Democrats today, I think there is this real sense that for them to have a shot
sentences.zh: 今天与民主党人交谈时，我感觉到他们有一种强烈的共识：为了在2022年保住国会两院中的任何一院，他们必须在

sentences.en: back at either chamber of Congress in 2022, they need to get to a place by, you know, next spring at the latest, where voters really feel like the economy is on track.
sentences.zh: 最晚明年春天之前，让选民真正感觉到经济正在步入正轨。

sentences.en: COVID is either a thing of the past or rapidly becoming a thing of the paSt.
sentences.zh: 新冠疫情要么已成为过去，要么正在迅速成为过去。

sentences.en: There is this sense that voters expect them to deliver and that they voted for Joe Biden because he said he was going to get the country out of COVID and get some stuff done.
sentences.zh: 选民们有一种预期，希望他们能兑现承诺，而且他们投票给乔·拜登是因为他说过要带领国家走出疫情并办成一些实事。

sentences.en: And they feel like that.
sentences.zh: 而他们觉得。

sentences.en: And they feel like that has mostly not happened yet.
sentences.zh: 而他们觉得这大部分还没有实现。

sentences.en: That's not to erase the real accomplishments of the administration with the rescue plan and a mass vaccination campaign.
sentences.zh: 这并不是要抹杀本届政府在救援计划和大规模疫苗接种运动中取得的真正成就。

sentences.en: That's clearly not what voters are thinking about right now when they're focused on what does my life look like today versus what I want it to look like today.
sentences.zh: 显然，当选民关注的是“我的生活现在是什么样”与“我希望它是什么样”时，他们想的并不是这些。

sentences.en: That would suggest that the passage of these giant bills still under negotiation by Democrats could propel the Democrats to that place you're describing where they are getting stuff done.
sentences.zh: 这是否意味着民主党目前仍在谈判中的这些巨额法案的通过，可以推动民主党达到你所描述的那种“办成实事”的状态？

sentences.en: I think there's a range of opinions in the Democratic Party about just how much getting stuff done in this particular way will help them.
sentences.zh: 我认为民主党内部对于以这种特定方式“办成实事”能在多大程度上帮助他们，存在着一系列不同的看法。

sentences.en: They could get the reconciliation package and the infrastructure bill done and still get shellacked in the midterm elections because it's just hard for the president's party in a midterm elections.
sentences.zh: 他们可能通过了和解方案和基础设施法案，但仍在中期选举中惨败，因为总统所在的政党在中期选举中本来就很难。

sentences.en: That's just how things tend to work in this country.
sentences.zh: 这就是这个国家政治运作的规律。

sentences.en: But if their entire domestic legislative agenda collapses, that would clearly be a humiliation for the party.
sentences.zh: 但如果他们整个国内立法议程崩溃，那对该党来说显然是一种羞辱。

sentences.en: It would be a really dark stain on Joe Biden's record in his first year in office.
sentences.zh: 那将是乔·拜登执政第一年记录上一个非常黑暗的污点。

sentences.en: And I think that's the point where you would start to see Democrats get profoundly pessimistic about their chances in 22.
sentences.zh: 我认为这就是你会开始看到民主党人对他们在22年的胜算感到极度悲观的时刻。

sentences.en: And look,
sentences.zh: 而且你看，

sentences.en: I think they're having a bit of a wake-up call moment here that they were successful in the 2020 presidential race because Joe Biden was able to put together this big coalition that ran from center-right white women in the
sentences.zh: 我认为他们在这里经历了一个警钟时刻，他们在2020年总统大选中取得成功，是因为乔·拜登能够建立起一个庞大的联盟，从郊区那些非常不喜欢唐纳德·特朗普的中间偏右白人女性，

sentences.en: suburbs who really disliked Donald Trump to a range of voters of color of many different ideologies to very, very left-wing young progressives.
sentences.zh: 到许多不同意识形态的有色人种选民，再到非常非常左翼的年轻进步派。

sentences.en: And they all locked arms against Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 他们都团结一致反对唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: What we're seeing is that when the Democrats have to go up against Republicans who aren't Donald Trump and who aren't acting in outrageous and offensive and divisive ways day after day after day,
sentences.zh: 我们看到的是，当民主党不得不面对那些不是唐纳德·特朗普，且没有日复一日地采取令人愤慨、冒犯和分裂行为的共和党人时，

sentences.en: it's harder to hold that coalition together.
sentences.zh: 要维持那个联盟就更难了。

sentences.en: And it's not like they had a whole lot of room to spare in 2020.
sentences.zh: 而且他们在2020年并没有太多的余地。

sentences.en: They held together that coalition just long enough to win the presidential race, but it was not an amazing year for them down ballot.
sentences.zh: 他们维持那个联盟的时间刚好够赢得总统大选，但那对他们来说并不是下层选举表现出色的一年。

sentences.en: And that's what they're looking at next year if they can't figure out a way to put that coalition back together.
sentences.zh: 如果他们找不到办法重新整合那个联盟，这就是他们明年将要面对的局面。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And it leaves them in the seemingly quite strange position of perhaps wanting Donald Trump to get more and more involved in Republican politics and perhaps even do the thing that Democrats say they dread him doing,
sentences.zh: 这让他们处于一个看似相当奇怪的境地：或许他们希望唐纳德·特朗普更多地参与共和党政治，甚至做出民主党声称最害怕他做的事情，

sentences.en: which is announce he's running for president immediately.
sentences.zh: 那就是立即宣布竞选总统。

sentences.en: Terry McAuliffe said it himself on the eve of the election in Virginia that, you know, it'd be bad for our political culture if this happened,
sentences.zh: 特里·麦考利夫在弗吉尼亚州选举前夕自己也说过，你知道，如果发生这种情况对我们的政治文化来说是不好的，

sentences.en: but it would have been helpful to him, Terry McAuliffe, if Trump were back on Twitter.
sentences.zh: 但如果特朗普回到推特上，对他——特里·麦考利夫——是有帮助的。

sentences.en: That's a very honest acknowledgement.
sentences.zh: 那是一个非常诚实的承认。

sentences.en: It really is.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And just the sense that that was a big tool that they had for half a decade.
sentences.zh: 这只是因为那是他们过去五年里拥有的一个重要工具。

sentences.en: But there is an element to this that is totally predictable, Michael, that these states, New Jersey and Virginia,
sentences.zh: 但迈克尔，这件事中有一个完全可以预见的因素，那就是新泽西州和弗吉尼亚州这两个州，

sentences.en: typically swing against the president's party the year after a new president comes into office.
sentences.zh: 通常会在新总统上任后的第一年倒向反对党。

sentences.en: We saw it happen.
sentences.zh: 我们已经见证过这种情况。

sentences.en: Barack Obama came into office in 2008, having won both states.
sentences.zh: 巴拉克·奥巴马在2008年上任，赢得了这两个州。

sentences.en: In 2009, both of them voted for Republican governors.
sentences.zh: 2009年，这两个州都投票选出了共和党州长。

sentences.en: It happened eight years later with Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 八年后，唐纳德·特朗普也发生了同样的情况。

sentences.en: He gets into office.
sentences.zh: 他上任了。

sentences.en: He doesn't carry New Jersey or Virginia.
sentences.zh: 他没有赢得新泽西州或弗吉尼亚州。

sentences.en: But the next year, his party gets utterly clobbered in both states.
sentences.zh: 但第二年，他所在的政党在这两个州都遭到了惨败。

sentences.en: There is just a pendulum nature to the way American politics works that I think a lot of Democrats hoped would not apply because Donald Trump is this disruptive, outrageous,
sentences.zh: 美国政治的运作方式有一种钟摆效应，我认为很多民主党人曾希望这种效应不会适用，因为唐纳德·特朗普对许多选民来说是一个具有破坏性、令人愤慨、

sentences.en: offensive figure to so many voters.
sentences.zh: 冒犯性的人物。

sentences.en: And one of the things that I think we found out this week is that while Trump distorts the nature of our politics in a lot of ways, gravity still kind of applies.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们本周发现的一件事是，虽然特朗普在很多方面扭曲了我们政治的本质，但重力法则依然适用。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Unless he's front and center.
sentences.zh: 除非他处于风口浪尖。

sentences.en: That sounds like a challenge to the former president.
sentences.zh: 这听起来像是对前总统的挑战。

sentences.en: Alex, thank you very much, as always.
sentences.zh: 亚历克斯，一如既往，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们很感激。

sentences.en: Thanks, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢，迈克尔。

sentences.en: It's good to be back.
sentences.zh: 很高兴回来。

sentences.en: On Wednesday night, the Democratic candidate for governor of New Jersey, Phil Murphy, was declared the winner by a slim margin of less than a single percentage point.
sentences.zh: 周三晚上，新泽西州民主党州长候选人菲尔·墨菲以不到一个百分点的微弱优势被宣布获胜。

sentences.en: Meanwhile.
sentences.zh: 与此同时。

sentences.en: Look, think about what we're talking about here.
sentences.zh: 听着，想想我们在这里讨论的问题。

sentences.en: People are upset and uncertain about a lot of things, from COVID to school to jobs to a whole range of things and the cost of a gallon of gasoline.
sentences.zh: 人们对很多事情感到不安和不确定，从新冠疫情到学校、工作，再到各种各样的事情，以及一加仑汽油的价格。

sentences.en: During a news conference, President Biden acknowledged his party's poor showing on Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 在新闻发布会上，拜登总统承认了他的政党在周二表现不佳。

sentences.en: And the reality that without Trump on the ballot, winning elections in states like Virginia will be harder for Democrats.
sentences.zh: 以及一个现实：如果没有特朗普在选票上，民主党在弗吉尼亚州这样的州赢得选举将更加困难。

sentences.en: Maybe.
sentences.zh: 也许吧。

sentences.en: No, I know we did, but I was running against Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 不，我知道我们做到了，但我当时是在和唐纳德·特朗普竞选。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们稍后回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: Madam President, this is a low, low point in the history of this body.
sentences.zh: 议长女士，这是本机构历史上一个非常、非常低谷的时刻。

sentences.en: On Wednesday, for the fourth time this year, Senate Republicans used the filibuster rule to block debate on a voting rights bill.
sentences.zh: 周三，参议院共和党人今年第四次利用阻挠议事规则阻止了对一项投票权法案的辩论。

sentences.en: The bill that was blocked, which is named after John Lewis, the civil rights leader and former House member,
sentences.zh: 这项被阻止的法案以民权领袖、前众议员约翰·刘易斯的名字命名，

sentences.en: is designed to counter a series of state laws passed by Republicans that restrict access to the ballot box.
sentences.zh: 旨在反击共和党通过的一系列限制选民投票权的州法律。

sentences.en: Just a single Republican, Senator Lisa Murkowski of Alaska, voted to allow the bill to be debated.
sentences.zh: 只有一位共和党人，来自阿拉斯加州的参议员丽莎·穆尔科斯基，投票支持对该法案进行辩论。

sentences.en: And the city of New York has reached a deal to rescue thousands of taxi drivers from crushing debt,
sentences.zh: 纽约市已达成一项协议，旨在将数千名出租车司机从沉重的债务中解救出来，

sentences.en: much of it created through reckless loan practices documented in a 2019 investigation by the Times.
sentences.zh: 其中大部分债务是由《纽约时报》2019年调查记录的鲁莽贷款行为造成的。

sentences.en: Under the deal, the largest single holder of cab drivers' loans will reduce the amount that each driver owes from an average of about $500,000 per driver to $170,000.
sentences.zh: 根据该协议，出租车司机贷款的最大单一持有者将把每位司机欠款的金额从平均约50万美元减少到17万美元。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Asta Chaturvedi, Nina Pawtuck, Diana Nguyen, and Luke Vanderplug.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由Asta Chaturvedi、Nina Pawtuck、Diana Nguyen和Luke Vanderplug制作。

sentences.en: It was edited by Lisa Chow and engineered by Chris Wood.
sentences.zh: 由Lisa Chow编辑，Chris Wood负责工程。

sentences.en: Original music by Marian Lozano.
sentences.zh: 原创音乐由Marian Lozano创作。

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Jim Brunberg and Ben Landsberg of Wonderly.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由Wonderly的Jim Brunberg和Ben Landsberg创作。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》节目中，我们正在为假期接待客人做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人感到宾至如归的小贴士。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是需要全黑环境才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是否会睡得不省人事。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是指他们需要什么样的光线？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢喝咖啡还是茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 您可以在《纽约时报》应用程序或您喜欢的任何播客平台上收听《Wirecutter Show》。
